column1: # Faust. Rule: every definition made at the top level of the file. name(args)=
# is function, and each clause of a pattern-matching definition (fact(0), fact(n))
# is its own function symbol; `process` is function (the entry point);
# name = library("x") and name = environment {...} are package; any other
# name = expr is constant. declare, import, and definitions local to a with,
# letrec or environment block are not definitions.
